title: MDSEval: A Meta-Evaluation Benchmark for Multimodal Dialogue Summarization

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing the distribution of scores assigned by Multimodal Large Language Model (MLLM) evaluators against human score distributions to identify algorithmic tendencies, such as score concentration (e.g., hedging assessments tightly around a score of 4) or skewness toward specific modalities.

Calculating the preference ratio between option A and option B in pairwise summary comparisons to detect whether the MLLM evaluators disproportionately favor an option based solely on its presentation order.
